text:
Maya: quickcheck failing for embed-service in eu-west-2 after v5.2.0 deploy — seeing intermittent 502 and 524 from synthetic probes hitting /generate. canary at 12%.

Priya: is the failure from the synthetic harness or from user traffic?

Maya: synthetic harness first. ran 60 probes -> 6 failures (4x 502 gateway, 2x 524 timeout). failures cluster on host ids eu2-node-03 and eu2-node-09. p95 up but tail spikes.

deploy-bot: Pausing rollout for embed-service at stage=canary (12%). No further promotions. To rollback: `deploy rollback embed-service --to-version=v5.1.8 --reason="synth 502/524"`.

Kevin: rollback makes sense. customer-facing route, tail latency is unacceptable. Also please pin the failing hosts out of rotation if we can.

Maya: issuing rollback now: `deploy rollback embed-service --to-version=v5.1.8 --force` — ETA ~3m to drain and switch traffic. Monitoring synth probes.

smokebot: post-rollback synthetic run (n=80) -> 0 failures, p95/p99 within baseline across eu-west-2.

Priya: added release_notes entry: "Reverted embed-service v5.2.0 due to intermittent 502/524 in eu-west-2 canary; rolled back to v5.1.8." Creating INF-2310 for runtime-team to triage grpc->http streaming and gateway proxy.

Kevin: add a large-payload case to the quickcheck suite and a host-isolation guard. Closing thread — will schedule targeted re-deploy after root cause.
